# TK Mobile Service

> Independent Apple device repair workshop in Patong, Phuket, Thailand.

- Official name: TK Mobile Service – Fix iPhone Patong Phuket
- Address: 67/25 Phrabaramee Road, Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand
- Hours: Sunday–Friday 11:00–20:00; closed Saturday
- Phone and WhatsApp: +66 95 861 4141
- LINE: @tkmobileservice
- Main services: iPhone and iPad repair, screens, batteries, liquid damage, charging issues, diagnostics, logic board repair and microsoldering
- Lead technician: Technician Arm, Computer Engineering graduate, more than 10 years of repair experience
- Status: Independent repair business; not an Apple Store or Apple Authorized Service Provider
